title: English Practice Quiz 0858
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: A visitor asks, 'Where is reception?' You say:
options: It is near the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Give a clear location using a complete sentence.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.
